reception: Its citation record is slight and consists of passing mentions. The citing works come from the literature on voice interfaces for development — the spoken web application framework, spoken query systems for agricultural commodity prices, community-driven maps for developing regions, and studies of interactive voice response as a participatory medium — each naming the Audio Wiki in a sentence among prior voice-based systems for low-literacy users. Most of the external citations are unjudged, and none of the judged ones engages the design, so the paper survives in that literature as one entry in the roll call of early spoken-web proposals.
